Phu Quoc specialty
May 2025 • Solo
Orders are placed at the order counter and you can wait at any seat you like. They ask me to make my own sauce, but I thought I didn't really understand, so the shop's kind sister made it for me. They made it a little spicy.
What I asked for was a full set of all the meat and squid. It was like somen and the soup tasted gentle and delicious. When I was observing other people how to use the sauce, I ate it with meat or squid, so I imitated it.
You can also order sugarcane juice. Spicy sauce and sour juice are perfect.
The squid was delicious.
The total was 100000 VND. I'm full. It is an easy shop to enter.

Pho for Enthusiasts
Dec 2024 • Friends
Well I came here by a recommendation of my tour guide, as he stated that this spot is one of the best spots for fresh noodles with sea food.
The store is spacious and well furnished, everything was clean and the instructions clear as well. You can order by 4 choices and somehow also with special orders.
While you ordered your bowl, you can prepare your spicy pot at the counter, the best thing four tourists is that you decide your level of spiciness.
The pager alarms you as your bowl is ready.
I ordered:
Fish Patty (Cha Ca)
Shrimp Patty (Cha Tom)
Squid (Muc)

And the bowl was top-notch! The squid was perfect and the shrimp patty as well. The soup matched the spicy pot too and the portions size is big enough to be saturated.

In total: A big recommendation here, as the price-performance-ratio is fantastic!

A very, very spicy fish soup!
Feb 2024 • Couples
This is an excellent and authentic Vietnamese fish noodle soup place. You order the soup and the type of fish that you want. I decided on a mixture of different fishcakes. You then create your own chilli, lime, salt, mixture to add to the soup. Beware, though, that the chillies are significantly more potent than the average European is used to. Initially, I thought I would die, as I had added too much chilli to my soup. I then got used to the taste and persevered. If I am ever in Phu Quoc again, I will be back!

so-so
Dec 2023 • Couples
This is my fifth visit to Vietnam. I wouldn't rave about it. It's just okay.
It contains meat, fish paste, squid, etc., and the noodles are thin. There are not many topping vegetables. The soup is also light in flavor, and you mix mustard, lemon, sugar, and salt, and wait for the noodles to be done. The waiter recommends adding Ajinomoto. It's not often used in Japanese households these days. Lol. Maybe the taste wasn't so good because I didn't add it? ! Personally, I think wider noodles taste better when they mix with the soup.
So, there are probably other phos of this level out there.
